descriptions.text: Sheol Glass Reaper Case. Forged in the fires of Sheol, the mysterious 15th level of the World Dungeon, these protective, expensive artifacts are built and sold by traveling Spider Reaper Minions. They also sell lollipops, which are said to be out of this world. When you absolutely, positively want to keep something safe, put it in this box. It will protect against most—but not all—forms of abuse. Warning: Every time you open this case, there is a 1.5% chance you will be blasted with the Sheol Fire spell. That's not a good thing. The item within the case will remain protected.

beats.headline: Opened, then read
beats.text: Sorted by value, the top item in Carl's inventory is Miss Quill's stuffed horse-riding soldier, Kimaris, and the second is the glass case it is stored in. The little door isn't locked, just a hinged flap held by a cheap-looking hook and eyebolt. Carl opens it, pulls the plush into his inventory, and only then reads the case: forged in Sheol, sold by Spider Reaper Minions, a 1.5 percent chance of Sheol Fire every time it opens. He should have read that first. He remembers a flash of light when they landed in the debris, and decides the System brought the case to his attention on purpose.

beats.headline: Like catching a firefly
beats.text: Four and a half minutes are left on the soul gem's red timer. Careful not to touch it, Carl closes the case round the floating gem like catching a firefly in his two hands, shuts the door and hooks it closed. He tries to pull the whole thing into his inventory and gets an error. He lets go. The case drops a couple of inches, clinks against the gem and floats there with it, while cracks form along the gem's edge. Most forms of abuse, the description said. He sits down on the floor, and Donut jumps into his lap to watch.

beats.headline: A caged sun
beats.text: Remex's scream jolts Carl's eyes open. They are not dead. The case has fallen to the floor, glowing red hot, light streaming from it like a miniature, caged sun, and the floorboards are bubbling. Case and gem have transformed themselves. Carl reads Status: Explosion Imminent in the two seconds before he grabs it, and pulls it into his inventory as the skin burns off his fingers. The new item is Carl's Doomsday Scenario, created by combining a massively overloaded soul crystal and a Sheol Glass Reaper Case.

beats.headline: Five more, unopened
beats.text: Bautista explains his stuffed animals. His most valuable, a legendary, came in a weird glass case. He has five more legendary rares and is afraid to open their cases: the description says there is a chance of being blasted with fire, and a Sage Sprite told him it could still trigger in a safe room, where he would be safe but case and item both would be ruined. He thinks he might open them in his inventory, but is too scared to try. It is the same kind of case Carl's Kimaris figure came in, the one that now holds Carl's Doomsday Scenario.

relations.note: five more, still closed round his legendary plush toys
